title: AI NPCs
description: Spawn NPCs that talk back — out loud, from their own mouth. They know what is happening around them, remember you, and can follow, fight, flee and use whatever you give them. Pick a voice per NPC from all of Fish Audio or the free built-in voices, press E to chat, or just talk in chat when you're nearby. Supports Groq, OpenRouter, OpenAI, DeepSeek and Ollama, with a guided first-run setup.
